entrypoints.summary: Ingester PushStream accepts streamed requests containing caller-provided TenantID.
Ingester.PushStream receives StreamWriteRequest messages and dispatches embedded writes.

affected_components.role: PushStream receives requests, constructs push context, and dispatches embedded writes.
Regression oracle for authenticated stream versus requested tenant mismatch rejection.

code_slices.fixed: Pinned implementation compares context tenant and req.TenantID for ordinary identities and returns PermissionDenied on mismatch.
code_slices.surrounding_context: Pinned implementation retains body-to-context injection after the check and has a distributor-worker identity exemption; this is outside the report-era V01 claim.
code_slices.vulnerable: The report identifies report-era PushStream as injecting req.TenantID into push context before invoking Push.

negative_controls: Repaired mismatch case is specified to return gRPC PermissionDenied.
observability.positive_marker: Submitted metric is readable in selected tenant namespace.

preconditions: Caller can reach the ingester gRPC PushStream service.

impact.affected_asset: Tenant-isolated Cortex metric data, including per-tenant quota and billing-relevant ingestion state.
impact.attacker_capability: Write samples into a victim-selected tenant namespace through PushStream despite authenticating as a different tenant.
impact.security_effect: Unauthorized cross-tenant metric ingestion and data poisoning.

causal_trace.summary: A caller reaching the ingester streaming RPC can supply TenantID in StreamWriteRequest while the stream has an authenticated tenant identity in gRPC context metadata.
The report-era flow derived write context tenant from message-body TenantID instead of binding it to the authenticated stream tenant.
PushStream injected req.TenantID into a derived context and invoked Push with the embedded request.
A metric sent by one tenant with another tenant's TenantID was ingested and readable in the other tenant namespace.

failure.operation: Inject the body-provided tenant into pushCtx and call Push(pushCtx, req.Request).

primary_invariant.statement: Each PushStream write must use the tenant identity authenticated for the stream and reject a request whose TenantID differs from that identity.
primary_invariant.violated_because: The report describes construction of the Push context from req.TenantID, controlled in each streamed message, rather than from authenticated gRPC context.

quality.review_notes: The audit supplies report-grounded mechanism, impact, recommendations, and says V01 was addressed through an alternative design; no vulnerable-to-fixed patch diff, release boundary, or test-run result is bundled. The pinned implementation includes a mismatch check, but also exempts synthetic distributor-worker identities; its bundled test documents a spoofing bypass. That residual current-code path is not treated as identical to report-era V01 or confirmed deployment behavior.

remediation.invariant_restored: Extract authenticated tenant from stream context, reject a differing request TenantID with PermissionDenied, and pass authenticated tenant to Push; subject PushStream to streaming request-signing protection.

affected_versions_or_commits.value: 26-04-2696-REP V1.1; report describes V01 as corrected through an alternative remediation design

oracle.channel: in-process Go regression test invoking PushStream
oracle.expected_negative: A mismatched message TenantID must not be accepted for the requested tenant.
oracle.expected_positive: For a stream authenticated as user-1 that submits TenantID user-2, PushStream returns a gRPC PermissionDenied status.
